claim_scope: open-loop replay of recorded baseline inputs; no physical improvement or PATH claim
interpretation: The original replay also coupled the early cap to recurrent-state warm-start/retry, producing hundreds of extra state interventions. The implementation now keeps the early guard projection-only and reserves warm-start/retry for the hysteretic 5.75 N main threshold. The cap still enforces its local invariant; replay does not model plant response, so no physical improvement is claimed.
